systems.owner: National Identification Registry (NIR), with OSD International as proposed technology and implementation partner
systems.tiers: proposed; not yet approved by the Legislature

note: The NIR describes a proposed NID-CRVS system as a framework linking national identification with civil registration, under a signed US$54 million OSD partnership still awaiting legislative approval (reported 14 September 2026); it states nothing on how or where births or deaths are recorded at registration offices.
